title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
partTitle: The Purpose of the Gifts of the Spirit
summaryZh: 彼此連結、同心合一，才能進入神為我們預備的新季節。
lines: I think there is something special even about the release of the gifts of the Spirit.
我認為，甚至聖靈恩賜的釋放也有特別之處。
Who else wants to grow in the functioning of the gifts of the Spirit—to prophesy more clearly, release healing, and share words of wisdom?
還有誰想讓聖靈恩賜更有效地運作，好更清楚地說預言、釋放醫治，並分享智慧的話語？
There is something about this element that only opens up to people who are trustworthy, who are in covenant, and who are in community, because they will use the gifts to strengthen the people of God.
這當中有某個特質，只向可信靠、活在約中並委身群體的人敞開，因為他們會運用恩賜來堅固神的子民。
What I am talking about is an atmosphere in which gifts multiply.
我所說的是一種讓恩賜倍增的氛圍。
We could invite the best preacher on the planet to come here and address all of us, and we would be encouraged.
我們可以邀請全世界最好的講員來到這裡向大家講道，大家也會因此得著鼓勵。
We are blessed to have some of the best worship leaders I have seen anywhere in the country.
我們很蒙福，能有幾位我在全國各地見過最好的敬拜主領。
他們一週又一週地來服事。
The ministry here—miracles happen week after week, over and over again.
這裡的服事也是如此——奇蹟一週又一週地發生，一再發生。
We can have it all and fail at who we are together as people.
我們可以擁有這一切，卻在我們群體彼此相待這件事上失敗。

If that doesn't happen here—a connection with another person, a moment of eye contact, an outstretched hand, appreciation, encouragement, and coming with the intention of strengthening someone else—we have failed.
如果這裡沒有這些事——與人連結、眼神交流、伸出援手、表達感謝、彼此鼓勵，以及帶著堅固他人的心意而來——那我們就失敗了。
If it is not there, we have failed, despite all the good things we have done.
如果沒有這些，即使我們做了許多好事，仍然是失敗了。
We are members of each other.
What we hear from the Lord—our teams spend time together, talking and praying—and what we hear...
我們從主領受的話——我們的團隊會一起相處、交談和禱告——以及我們所聽見的……
We have friends all over the world, all over the country, calling and visiting us.
我們在世界各地、全國各地都有朋友打電話來，也來探望我們。
Ben Fitzgerald was here a couple of weeks ago.
幾週前，班・費茲傑羅來過這裡。
We had such a fruitful time with him.
我們和他有一段非常豐盛的時光。
He ministered to me, my wife Linda, and our teams were very encouraged.
他服事了我和我的妻子琳達，我們的團隊也大受鼓勵。
We've had other people call us.
也有其他人打電話給我們。
I've been to Brazil with Linda, with Randy Clark, Leif Hetland, and others.
我曾和琳達、藍迪・克拉克、萊夫・赫特蘭等人一起去過巴西。
The words of encouragement about our future are really very meaningful.
那些鼓勵我們、談到未來的話，對我們來說確實很有意義。
I am both grateful and very serious about this next season, realizing that there are a few things I want to strengthen before we enter this next phase.
我既感恩，也很認真看待接下來的季節；我知道，在進入下一個階段之前，有幾件事我想要加以堅固。
Does this make any sense to you?
你們聽得懂我的意思嗎？
I am not trying to scare anyone.
As someone who at least tries to hear from the Lord what He says and does, I can say that this gathering is important.
作為一個至少努力聆聽主所說、所行的人，我可以說，這次聚集很重要。
I'm going to dedicate the next week or two after this to dealing with a few other things that I feel the Lord wants us to pay attention to.
接下來的一兩週，我會專心處理其他幾件事；我覺得主希望我們留意這些事。
I believe—and I don't think it's a coincidence—that we're approaching a new year, believe it or not.
我相信——而且我不認為這是巧合——我們就要迎接新的一年了，信不信由你。
Oh, some of you are probably ready, and you're annoying me.
喔，你們有些人可能已經準備好了，你們真讓我受不了。
I couldn't believe it; I was in the store a month ago, and they already had Christmas merchandise on display.
我簡直不敢相信；一個月前我去商店，他們就已經把聖誕商品擺出來展示了。
They were at Hobby Lobby back in July.
早在七月，Hobby Lobby 就已經有聖誕商品了。
Well, I love Hobby Lobby because I love the people who own them.
我喜歡 Hobby Lobby，因為我喜歡擁有這家公司的那些人。
They really...they are amazing, amazing people.
他們真的……他們是非常、非常棒的人。
Indeed, I know David Green and am very grateful to him.
確實，我認識大衛・格林，也非常感謝他。
So my plea is that the Lord help us to have unity of thought and focus together, so that we can confidently enter the next season and see the breakthroughs we were born to have.
所以我懇求主幫助我們同心合意、聚焦一致，好讓我們能有信心地進入下一個季節，看見我們生來就要經歷的突破。
So why don't you stand up?
那麼，請大家站起來，好嗎？
Thank you for being here today, honestly.
真的，謝謝你們今天來到這裡。
And thank you for your sensitivity, because it is not easy for me to describe the hopes and burdens of my heart.
也謝謝你們的體恤，因為要描述我心中的盼望和負擔，對我來說並不容易。
It is tangible today in what I feel and believe, what God is doing in us and through us.
今天我所感受、所相信的，以及神在我們裡面和透過我們所做的事，都真實可感。
And I expect a major breakthrough.
我期待一個重大的突破。
So, if you don't mind, take the hand of the person next to you.
所以，如果你不介意，請牽起旁邊那個人的手。
Those of you watching at home, I don't know, maybe grab your hand or someone else's hand in the room.
在家收看的朋友，我不知道，也許可以握住自己的手，或握住房間裡另一個人的手。
Let's just take a short moment to pray together.
我們一起花一點時間禱告吧。
